prompt.en: Which new province did Canada establish after soldiers retook Fort Garry in 1870?
prompt.fr: Quelle nouvelle province le Canada a-t-il créée après que des soldats eurent repris Fort Garry en 1870?

explanation.en: Troops arrived in 1870 and took Fort Garry back. Riel crossed into the United States, and out of the settlement came a new province, Manitoba.
explanation.fr: Des troupes sont arrivées en 1870 et ont repris Fort Garry. Riel est passé aux États-Unis, et de cette colonie est née une nouvelle province, le Manitoba.

source.quote: Riel fled to the United States and Canada established a new province: Manitoba.

verification.evidence: Ottawa sent soldiers to retake Fort Garry in 1870. Riel fled to the United States and Canada established a new province: Manitoba. … 1870 – Manitoba, Northwest Territories 1871 – British Columbia … 1905 – Alberta, Saskatchewan
